title: The six Bonds before Pattinson
note: One film for every actor who's played 007, in order. Which one's yours?

items.why: Sean Connery · the one that set the template
George Lazenby · one film, and a great one
Roger Moore · Bond at his most fun
Timothy Dalton · the darker Bond, years early
Pierce Brosnan · Bond for the 90s (and the N64)
Daniel Craig · the reboot that rewrote Bond
